note: Tier-1 threat deck, 146 (Matt's threat card standard, 2026-11-07): each card has one consequence, rarely two, on the nearest player (the one whose node is closest to its token) or the board; one counter option or two, never in a currency its harm takes. Counters: 3 energy, 3 ambassadors, 6 insight, 3 research cubes, 6 chips, 2 tags or 12 credits. Value lines price at configs/agents/values.json (a troop 9: placed 5 plus its strike). Source: experiments/results/146_threat_standard/threat_cards.py.
